verdict.rationale: Abacum is an FP&A platform, so explaining variance is a fair question for this kind of product. The pack shows budgets alongside live actuals (abacum-docs-15), traceable numbers (abacum-docs-9), AI inside the model (abacum-docs-2) and an auto-updating investor narrative (abacum-docs-8). None of these documents explaining budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance drivers; they are adjacent capabilities, so they earn no credit.
